$comment: THE V8 SINGLE-DRAWING-PATH BASELINE — recorded 2026-10-08 (V8 phase 0), to be burned to zero.
Every entry here is an admin screen that draws a profile WITHOUT going through
components/admin/v8/ProfileViewer.tsx. Phase 0 built the harness and converted no
screens, so this is the whole starting state: 29 drawing calls across 18 files.
WHAT EACH PRIMITIVE MEANS, and why it is a violation:
V7Drawing / V7Thumb / V7Plate / drawInner — lib/design/v7-draw.ts. A profile KIND
out of a nine-entry table plus a few leg lengths: a picture of the CATEGORY of
flashing, not of what the customer drew. No seven-bend custom, no hem kick, no
bend handedness (CLAUDE.md rule #12).
LazyProfileThumb / PastProfileThumb / ShopJobDrawing — a base64 PNG of real
geometry, captured once at thumbnail resolution. Right shape, but it cannot be
enlarged and read off, which is exactly what the V8 full-size view is for.
THE COUNTS ARE EXACT IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. More fails (a drawing path was added);
fewer ALSO fails, asking for the number to be lowered here and `baselineTotal`
lowered by the same amount. That is how each phase's progress gets written down
instead of happening invisibly.
NEVER add an entry, and never raise a count, to make a build pass — CLAUDE.md
rule #37. `baselineTotal` may only go down.
pointsToSvgPath (lib/data/job-screen.ts) was MISSED by the first draft of this gate
and added before this baseline was committed. It draws the REAL saved points, so the
shape is right — but it carries no bend angles, no segment lengths, no hems and no
painted side, and its own comment says it is deliberately not FlashDraft's renderer.
It is the subtlest violation on the list and the reason the pattern set is an
inventory of what this codebase really does rather than a guess at it.
Which phase retires which file is listed in docs/COMMAND_CENTER_V8_AUDIT.md.
